message: uv.lock was locked with exclude-newer-span = "P1W", but exclude-newer in pyproject.toml (line 9) is "7 days" now (uv compares the units as written, so 7 days is not 1 week), so uv sync --locked and uv lock --check fail until uv lock runs again
fix: Run uv lock and commit uv.lock, or set exclude-newer back in pyproject.toml if the change was not intended
